info.name: Used by customers to create new purchase orders in ESP.

params.name: customerCode
params.description: The unique key of the customer who created the purchase order.

items.docs:
The customer identified by the `customerCode` creates new distinct
purchase orders. Each requested purchase order is identified by its
`purchaseOrderNumber` property. In background processing of bulk orders
each single purchase order is treated as a separate transaction. The
status of purchase orders can be queried with the `readPurchaseOrders`
operation.

info.name: Used by customers to update existing purchase orders.

params.name: customerCode
params.description: The unique key of the customer who created the purchase order.

items.docs:
The customer identified by the `customerCode` updates one or more of his
own orders. Updating a purchase order does not allow to delete values
that are already part of the purchase order. It is only possible to
change or add values. Key attributes of business parties and order lines
cannot be changed. Purchase orders to be updated are identified by the
`purchaseOrderNumber` property of the elements of the `purchaseOrders`
array. Order lines that are added or updated are identified by their key

info.name: Used by business parties linked to a purchase order to read one or more existing purchase orders.

params.name: customerCode
params.description: The unique key of the customer who created the purchase order.

items.docs:
Reading purchase orders is accessible to all business parties that are linked as
`parties` to the requested purchase order. The information provided as a response
depends on the permissions for the business party's role.

If the request does not fail completely, the response contains the
purchase order for each successful read or a problem description for a
failed read of a single order.

info.name: Used by customers to cancel all or only a selection of order lines from one or more purchase orders.

params.name: customerCode
params.description: The unique key of the customer who created the purchase order.

items.docs:
The orders and any affected lines are referenced in the request body.

A single order line is identified by a JSON object that contains only
the order attributes that are key attributes in the customer's order
configuration.

To cancel a complete order, i.e. all order lines of that order, the
attribute `orderLines` is omitted.
